title: pi-arm64-exec
brief: A Pi extension that restricts the agent to a single `arm64_exec` tool — compiling and running native Apple Silicon ARM64 assembly via `xcrun clang` — to stop Astra shelling out to python3, ruby, and perl for file ops.
caveat: runs compiled ARM64 assembly natively on macOS with libc access and no sandbox.
details: An X announcement of pi-arm64-exec, a Pi extension that gives the agent exactly one tool — doing file read/edit work in arm64 assembly — to stop the Astra model shelling out to python3, ruby, and perl for file operations. The idea: give the agent a single fast native tool for file ops instead of letting it reach for interpreted languages. The link is the announcement; the actual repo link was promised in a follow-up tweet, so treat this as a pointer rather than a usable resource. (x.com is not directly fetchable from this environment; the breakdown reflects the announcement's subject as curated.)
